thread:
incident-bot: Pager alert: billing-metrics-service emitted 5xx on /ingest and token-count variance > 12% vs baseline for the last 10m. Auto-escalation to oncall.
maya_oncall: seeing noise on dashboards, token_count_delta spiking across eu/us, some delayed batches in kafka-consumers. Paging in.
leo_sre: joining — loading last 20m logs. running: `kubectl logs -n billing metrics-emitter-*/ --since=20m | grep WARN | tail -n 50`
sam_billing: flagged multiple overage alerts firing for same accounts, some customers got email flags. Can we mute alerts until we know impact? :grimacing:
nina_support: customer comms: two customers already opened tickets about unexpected charges. I can draft a hold-notice if we decide to pause alerts.
maya_oncall: agree mute alerts. sam, can you toggle the alerter silence? I don't have perms.
sam_billing: doing short mute on /billing/overage-rules for 30m now. :ok_hand: (actioned)
leo_sre: logs show emitter retries -> backpressure -> bursts of duplicated events. excerpt:
```
2024-10-12T18:03:12Z WARN emitter: retrying batch id=abc123 reason=UpstreamUnavailable
2024-10-12T18:03:14Z INFO emitter: ack delayed seq=789 ttl=120s
2024-10-12T18:03:15Z ERROR aggregator: out-of-order token delta detected id=abc123 dup=1
```
maya_oncall: that dup=1 looks like a re-sent batch, could cause double-counting in short window.
leo_sre: spinning up a read-only recon job to compare emitter-x logs vs ledger tally: `python tools/recon_tokens.py --from 2024-10-12T17:50Z --to 2024-10-12T18:05Z --emit-source emitter-a`
kevin_pm: what is customer impact? are bills already calculated and charged?
sam_billing: billing job runs nightly. these flags are pre-charge alerts. some customers saw overage emails because the alerting uses near-realtime tallies. Actual invoices not yet processed but could affect trust.
maya_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) keep alerts muted; 2) start recon to measure duplication rate; 3) backfill-correct any transient duplicates before nightly billing; 4) notify support to hold billing escalation.
leo_sre: recon job started, ETA ~7m. I'll also add a short circuit in emitter to drop obvious replays (dedupe by batch id) as hotfix if duplication > 5%. Rolling patch to 2 replica subset. deploy-bot: deploy started for metrics-emitter dedupe fix -> canary on ae-zone-1.
deploy-bot: canary succeeded on 2/2 pods, rolling to remaining pods.
maya_oncall: recon results: dup-rate = 6.3% peak, most duplicates from emitter-a -> kafka partition 4, backlog correlated with GC pause on node b-7.
leo_sre: GC causing emitter to re-send batches. I'm patching kube params to lower GC pause windows and adding retry-backoff jitter. Hotfix applied to ae-zone-1; monitoring.
sam_billing: alerting stay muted until we confirm backfill corrects counts. I'll coordinate with accounting to suppress auto-email for any overage flags in last 2 hours.
nina_support: drafting message to impacted customers: short note saying we detected alerting noise, not final invoices, we are reconciling and will follow up within 24h. Ping me if legal needs to review.
kevin_pm: good. want to create tech postmortem and a follow-up action item list: durable dedupe in emitter, better alert gating, nightly repro check, and customer-facing playbook.
leo_sre: added TODOs in the incident board. recon backfill job started, estimated run 25m for 48h window.
maya_oncall: once backfill finishes, we'll unmute alerts and watch for any residual drift. if no further dup spikes for 1h, declare mitigated.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigating, severity=high, runbook_ref=https://go/infra/runbooks/billing-duplication. Incident channel will remain open for updates.
maya_oncall: thanks everyone. I'll stay on this for the next hour and hand off to leo at +1h. :coffee:
